headerDisplay: Control your Trimlight Edge lights from Apple Home. You need Trimlight API credentials (Client ID and Client Secret), which you can apply for via [Trimlight's open API support page](https://trimlight.com/support/does-the-edge-have-an-open-api).
footerDisplay: All controllers on your Trimlight account are added automatically.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name shown in the Homebridge logs.

exposeAs.title: Show in Home as
exposeAs.description: Light (recommended) is included in "turn off all the lights" and Siri light commands. Switch shows a plain power switch.

pollingIntervalSeconds.title: Status refresh interval (seconds)
pollingIntervalSeconds.description: How often to check the Trimlight cloud for changes made outside of Apple Home (e.g. in the Trimlight app or by a schedule).
